# @immediately-run/safe-content

> The immediately.run safe renderer: non-executable MDX/Markdown as data, with no evaluator anywhere in the pipeline (TRUST_MODES_SPEC §5.1). Extracted from @immediately-run/sdk's safeContent tier (PLATFORM_LAYERING_SPEC §4, R3-279); the SDK re-exports it, so no import path changes. (v0.1.1)

The non-executable MDX renderer: untrusted Markdown/MDX-syntax content rendered
as DATA, with no evaluator anywhere in the pipeline (TRUST_MODES_SPEC §5.1). Every
security property in one sentence: JSX tags resolve ONLY through a component
registry by name with literal string props only — unknown tags render their
children inert; expression attributes are dropped; URLs pass an allowlist;
wiki-links resolve through the shared link-space resolver.

Consumed directly, or re-exported byte-compatibly through `@immediately-run/sdk`
(`@immediately-run/sdk/safeContent/*`) — no import path changes needed either way.

## Exports

- `ParseSafeMdastOptions` (interface)
- `RenderMdastOptions` (interface)
- `SafeContentComponents` (interface)
- `SafeContentProps` (interface)
- `SafeMdastNode` (interface)
- `SafeMdxAttribute` (interface)
- `WikiLinkToken` (interface)
- `WikiPart` (type)
- `parseSafeMdast` (function) — Parse untrusted Markdown/MDX-syntax source to an mdast tree with **no evaluator in the pipeline**: JSX-as-data (no acorn), GFM on, the expression extension OFF, no raw-HTML re-parse.
- `parseWikiInner` (function) — Parse the `[[label|target]]` / `[[target]]` inner text (label first, then target — the §13.1 order), or `null` for an empty target (leave the literal `[[…]]`).
- `renderMdast` (function) — Render a safe-parsed mdast tree to React.
- `SafeContent` (function)
- `sanitizeUrl` (function) — Return the URL if its scheme is allowed (or it is relative/anchor), else `undefined`.
- `splitWikiLinks` (function) — Split a text string on its `[[…]]` runs into ordered text / wiki parts, or `null` when there is no usable wiki-link (so the caller keeps the text node untouched).

## Non-negotiables when embedding

- A **T2 tool, not a platform gate**: it stops content executing as code; it
  certifies nothing to the host — data-fencing is still required for readers.
- `@immediately-run/mdx-plugins` is a deliberate runtime dep (the anti-drift
  coupling): the compiled and interpreted paths share ONE grammar.
- `react` is a peer the host provides.
